szoveg_eredeti:
I'm Henry. I seem to have frequent silly ideas for games, so I built a workflow for creating them and platform for hosting them. Free for creators and players, all just for the fun of it.

With OSG, install the skill in Claude Code or Codex and build a game just by asking. When you are ready, connect your OSG account to you agent, and it'll submit, and go live on the site within minutes.

Why I built this: I found myself rebuilding the same tricky bits over and over - Leaderboards, Multiplayer rooms, Phone controls etc. - so I thought i'd build them once more, and offer them to others.

Play one and tell me which you'd send to a friend

Make one, even a daft one, and post the link in the comments. I'll play every single one today.

Weboldal: https://oursilly.games
